premise: Acorn wishes to be as tall as the big oaks at once; after the rain Duckling plants her in the soft mud by the pond, and the first thing she grows is a root, down, before a shoot comes up.
inspiration: Jack and the Beanstalk, turned slow and true: no magic and no giant, just a root going down before a shoot goes up.
lesson: Growing takes time, and it starts where nobody can see.
learning: An acorn grows a root down first, then a shoot up

en-US.title: Acorn Grows Down First
en-US.text: Little {acorn:enter} Acorn looked up at the big oaks. [excited] I want to be THAT tall! {acorn:live hold} She clasped her hands, squeezed her eyes tight and wished. Along rolled {pinecone:enter} Pinecone. [giggles] Wishing isn't enough, she said. {pinecone:wobble} You need soft ground, and a drink. {acorn:live resume} Acorn opened her eyes and bounced. {canvas:rain 0.6 14s} {sfx:rain-bed} Pitter-patter, down came the rain, and the mud by the pond went squishy. {duckling:enter} Duckling came waddling. {duckling:face happy} Quack! Just right for planting! He dug a hole, and in went Acorn, {acorn:face happy} snug and cosy. [whispers] Then they waited, and {duckling:live hold} Duckling tucked his head under his wing. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 18s} The sun came out. {acorn:face surprised} Was Acorn growing UP? No, DOWN! A tiny root {acorn:shake} wriggled into the mud. And then… {acorn:glow} {sfx:sprout} a green shoot poked up! {duckling:live resume} Duckling popped out, shook and quacked. {pinecone:live} Pinecone opened her scales wide in the sun, then closed them snug, smiling. [softly] Someday, Acorn will be as tall as the oaks. {acorn:hearts}

es-ES.title: Bellota crece hacia abajo
es-ES.text: La pequeña {acorn:enter} Bellota miró los grandes robles. [excited] ¡Yo quiero ser así de ALTA! {acorn:live hold} Juntó las manitas, cerró los ojos muy fuerte y pidió un deseo. Llegó rodando {pinecone:enter} Piña. [giggles] Con desear no basta, le dijo. {pinecone:wobble} Necesitas tierra blandita, y agua. {acorn:live resume} Bellota abrió los ojos y dio un bote. {canvas:rain 0.6 14s} {sfx:rain-bed} Plic, ploc, empezó a llover, y el barro junto a la charca se puso blandito. {duckling:enter} Patito llegó contoneándose. {duckling:face happy} ¡Cuac! ¡Perfecto para plantar! Hizo un hoyito, y allá que entró Bellota, {acorn:face happy} calentita. [whispers] Esperaron, y {duckling:live hold} Patito escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. {canvas:sunshine 0.8 18s} Salió el sol. {acorn:face surprised} ¿Crecía Bellota hacia ARRIBA? ¡No, hacia ABAJO! Una raicita {acorn:shake} se metió en el barro. Y entonces… {acorn:glow} {sfx:sprout} asomó un tallito verde. {duckling:live resume} Patito sacó la cabeza, se sacudió y dijo: ¡cuac! {pinecone:live} Piña abrió sus escamas al sol, y luego las cerró, sonriendo. [softly] Algún día, Bellota será tan alta como los robles. {acorn:hearts}

rain-bed.prompt: light gentle rain pattering on grass and a still pond

sprout.prompt: a tiny soft pop of a seedling breaking through damp soil
